name: Ice giants

variantInfo.name: Ice giant
notes: Standard ice giant; spawns at the Frozen Waste Plateau in the Wilderness (9 spawns).
Ice giants also spawn in non-Wilderness dungeons, but Krystilia counts only the Wilderness kills.

variantInfo.name: Ice giant
notes: Higher-level ice giant variant found only in the Wilderness Slayer Cave.
Grants more Slayer XP (100) than the standard variant.
The cave is multicombat and cannonable but a popular player-killing hotspot.

locationComparison.name: Frozen Waste Plateau
notes: 9 ice giant spawns in the western Wilderness (around level 50).
Multi and cannon status are not wiki-stated, so treated conservatively as false.

locationComparison.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave (ice giants)
notes: 14 spawns of the combat level 67 variant; multicombat and cannonable.
A popular player-killing hotspot; keep near one-click teleport range.

taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 261 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Ice giants is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
Krystilia assigns ice giants as a Wilderness-only task; only Wilderness ice giant kills (Frozen Waste Plateau or Wilderness Slayer Cave) count.
Ice giants are weak to fire (100%); fire spells and any melee are effective given their very low defence.
The Wilderness Slayer Cave holds a higher-level combat level 67 variant that grants 100 Slayer XP and is multicombat/cannonable.
Both spawn areas are in the Wilderness; keep low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport ready.
recommendedMethod: Kill ice giants at the Frozen Waste Plateau or, for faster XP with a cannon, the level 67 variant in the Wilderness Slayer Cave. Ice giants have very low defence, so any strong melee weapon (or fire spells) works; wear low-risk Wilderness gear and keep a one-click escape teleport ready.
